name: Application Gateway
summary: Layer 7 load balancer and reverse proxy with WAF, routing HTTP traffic by host name or path to one or more backends.
useWhen: You need a regional internet-facing entry point with a WAF in front of App Service, VMs or an API
You need host- or path-based routing to different backends from one gateway
avoidWhen: You need HTTPS/TLS termination with certificate management (not covered by this module yet)
You need global (multi-region) routing and CDN caching (use Front Door instead, optionally in front of this gateway)
